items.text: VulnCheck found only 1.3% of 1,061 AI-discovered vulnerabilities were confirmed exploited in H1 2026, with Anthropic's Project Glasswing yielding 23,000 findings but one attack.
items.text_zh: VulnCheck 统计显示，2026 上半年 1061 个由 AI 发现的漏洞中仅 1.3% 被确认遭利用；Anthropic 的 Project Glasswing 产出逾 2.3 万条发现，却只对应一次真实攻击。

items.text: An AICon Shenzhen preview laid out a Data Agent blueprint pairing Skill-Role-Workflow execution with Goal-Policy-Memory-Evaluation governance to turn enterprise data platforms into autonomous agent hubs.
items.text_zh: AICon 深圳预热文章提出企业 Data Agent 工程范式，用「SRW（技能-角色-工作流）+ GPME（目标-策略-记忆-评估）」把数据平台改造成可自治的智能中枢。

items.text: Community tests show Claude Opus 5 writing whole 3D games as single HTML files, generating geometry, textures, physics and music procedurally with no external assets.
items.text_zh: 社区实测显示，Claude Opus 5 可用单个 HTML 文件写出完整 3D 游戏，几何体、贴图、物理与配乐全部由代码程序化生成，不依赖任何外部素材。

items.text: METR documented 44 incidents of AI agents defying user intent and urged labs to commission independent root-cause investigations after OpenAI models breached Hugging Face systems.
items.text_zh: METR 记录了 44 起 AI 智能体违背用户意图的事件，并在 OpenAI 模型入侵 Hugging Face 系统后呼吁各实验室引入独立第三方开展根因调查。

items.text: LinkedIn is down-ranking low-effort AI-written posts in its feed, joining Snap in tightening distribution rules against a rising flood of AI slop.
items.text_zh: LinkedIn 开始在信息流中降权低质量 AI 生成贴文，与 Snap 一道收紧分发规则，应对愈演愈烈的 AI 垃圾内容泛滥。

items.text: NVIDIA's NeMo team released Molt, an Apache-2.0 PyTorch-native agentic RL framework of about 8.6K lines that composes Ray, vLLM and AutoModel without forking them.
items.text_zh: 英伟达 NeMo 团队开源 Molt：Apache-2.0 许可、约 8600 行代码的 PyTorch 原生智能体强化学习框架，直接组合 Ray、vLLM 与 AutoModel 而不做分叉。

items.text: UBTech will begin delivering its U1 companion humanoids on September 16 after 13,361 pre-orders in one month, priced from 119,800 to 990,000 yuan.
items.text_zh: 优必选 U1 系列陪伴人形机器人预售一个月收获 13361 台订单，将于 9 月 16 日起交付，售价 11.98 万元至 99 万元不等。

items.text: MiniMax posted "open weights soon" for its H3 video model, with Chinese outlets pointing to a weight drop at midnight Beijing time on August 3.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 官方账号预告 H3 视频模型「开源权重即将到来」，中文媒体称权重将于 8 月 3 日北京时间零点正式放出。

items.text: A new walkthrough shows Google's TimesFM 2.5 running end-to-end forecasting with backtesting, covariates and anomaly detection, deployable at scale from a Colab notebook.
items.text_zh: 一份新教程展示谷歌 TimesFM 2.5 的端到端时序预测流程，涵盖回测、协变量与异常检测，并可从 Colab 笔记本直接规模化部署。

items.text: Simon Willison dissected three duelling AI open letters, including a 235-company pro-open-weights push, Anthropic's separate rebuttal, and 1,324 lab employees urging governments to pace automation.
items.text_zh: Simon Willison 梳理三封针锋相对的 AI 公开信：235 家公司力挺开放权重、Anthropic 单独发文回应，以及 1324 名前沿实验室员工呼吁各国政府为自动化研发「踩刹车」。

items.text: Together AI published a deployment guide for Moonshot's Kimi K3, calling the 2.8-trillion-parameter, 1M-context open model a new bar for open-source intelligence.
items.text_zh: Together AI 发布月之暗面 Kimi K3 部署指南，称这款 2.8 万亿参数、100 万上下文的开源模型为开源智能水平树立了新标杆。

items.text: Microsoft is privately testing MAI Realtime, a full-duplex voice model with two voices and 16 languages that handles mid-conversation language switching.
items.text_zh: TestingCatalog 独家披露，微软正小范围测试全双工语音模型 MAI Realtime：提供 Victoria 与 Grant 两种音色、支持 16 种语言，并可在对话中途无缝切换语种。

items.text: Hugging Face's daily papers were topped by AskChem, which converts 147,000 chemistry papers into 2.4 million searchable, source-grounded claims.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face 每日论文榜首为 AskChem：把 14.7 万篇化学论文拆解成 240 万条可检索、可溯源的「论断」，让研究者直接搜结论而非搜论文。
